NESTNOTE F-Droid Repo

F-Droid repository for NESTNOTE, a local-first Android notes app.

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Ravi-katta-dev/NESTNOTE/gh-pages/fdroid/repo
